title: Rubio praises India’s energy diversification, Times Now reports
excerpt: Times Now reports that Marco Rubio praised India’s energy diversification efforts and identified Venezuela as a potential oil source.
author: LokkeeVerse
content:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio praised India’s efforts to diversify its energy sources while addressing concerns about its continued purchases of Russian oil, according to a Times Now report summary.

The report’s headline also identifies Venezuela as a potential oil source raised by Rubio. The supplied metadata does not provide details about any proposed supply arrangement or changes to India’s oil purchases.
seoTitle: Rubio on India’s Energy Diversification and Russian Oil
metaDescription: Times Now reports Rubio praised India’s energy diversification while addressing Russian oil purchases and naming Venezuela as a potential source.
